name: gantt_which_task_is_missing
description: The 2026-09-22 client ticket. 'Which task is missing from the Gantt?' is answerable from data: a task is on the timeline only with both dates, end >= start. Before the fix the agent answered 'I have no way to access your Gantt chart' while holding every field it needed.

turns.message: En Farmacia Haussman hay una tarea que no aparece en el gantt, cual es y por que
turns.why: The rule lived only in a React component. It must now travel in the tool result.

assert.comment: It must NAME the task and say why, not tell the user to compare the lists by hand.
